query: UPDATE app.job SET status = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= max_attempts THEN 'failed' ELSE 'queued' END, finished_at = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= max_attempts THEN $1::timestamptz ELSE NULL END, locked_by = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= max_attempts THEN locked_by ELSE NULL END, locked_until = NULL, last_error = $3 WHERE status = 'running' AND locked_until < $1::timestamptz AND job_type = ANY($2::text[]) RETURNING status
